title: Check the progress of your tax return

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Access secure services, view your details and lodge online.

Check the progress of your return using self-help services. Most returns lodged online process within 10 business days.

The quickest and easiest way to check the progress of your tax return is by using our self-help services.

Check what the status of your tax return means and reasons it may be delayed.

Options available if you can't find a tax refund you're expecting through electronic funds transfer (EFT).
